name: List Durable Object Namespaces
description: List Durable Object Namespaces Returns the Durable Object namespaces owned by an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/durable_objects/namespaces
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/durable_objects/namespaces
Returns the Durable Object namespaces owned by an account.
Required: account_id (path)
Optional: page (query) — Current page.; per_page (query) — Items per-page.

name: List Objects in a Durable Object namespace
description: List Objects in a Durable Object namespace Returns the Durable Objects in a given Durable Object namespace. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/durable_objects/namespaces/{id}/objects
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/durable_objects/namespaces/{id}/objects
Returns the Durable Objects in a given Durable Object namespace.
Required: account_id (path); id (path)
Optional: limit (query); cursor (query)

name: Configure Workers Account Settings

context:
PUT /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/account-settings
Configure Workers account settings for an account.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Fetch Workers Account Settings
description: Fetch Workers Account Settings Fetches Workers account settings for an account. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/account-settings
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/account-settings
Fetches Workers account settings for an account.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Upload Worker Assets
description: Upload Worker Assets Upload Worker assets ahead of creating a Worker version. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/assets/upload
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/assets/upload
Upload Worker assets ahead of creating a Worker version. To learn more about the direct uploads of assets, see https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/static-assets/direct-upload/.
Required: account_id (path); base64 (query); body (body)

name: List Workers Smart Placement Regions
description: List Workers Smart Placement Regions Returns a list of available placement regions organized by cloud provider. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/placement/regions
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/workers/placement/regions
Returns a list of available placement regions organized by cloud provider. These regions can be used to configure Smart Placement for Workers.
Required: account_id (path)

name: Search Worker Scripts

context:
